description: Task-tracking hooks for the org event queue. Every script here works against the queue (~/.claude/org-updates/<session>.jsonl) or the consuming repo's own tracked org files, and survives a stopped Emacs; none writes to an org file. Hooks that enforce claude-code-ide-org's OWN repo conventions are deliberately not shipped — they would assert conventions a consuming repo does not have, since CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR is the consumer's root (doc-sync-check was removed for exactly that). TIME TRACKING IS NOT WIRED HERE: the guidepost, permission-block and clock rows ship as scripts under bin/hooks/ but are left unwired, because a hook has no disabled state — wired and unwired are the only forms available. `claude-org-setup --time` adds them back. A repo with its own .claude/settings.json wiring should NOT also enable this plugin's hooks, or every queue line is appended twice.
